Architecture & System Design

Pac-Man RL: Technical Specification

Deep Reinforcement Learning Lab
1. End-to-End System Architecture & Block Diagram
High-level block diagram depicting the closed-loop reinforcement learning environment: the deterministic headless simulation engine, 6-channel spatial tensor observation, multi-layer convolutional feature extractor (GridCNN), and the neuro-symbolic safety filter.
Figure 1: Full-pipeline architectural schematic connecting the Gym environment, GridCNN policy network, and runtime action filter.
Spatial Tensor Representation
Game state is projected into an exact 6-channel tensor (Walls, Pellets, Power, Pac-Man, Active Ghosts, Frightened Ghosts) preserving 2D topological corridor connectivity.
Universal Spatial Bridge
AdaptiveAvgPool2d((15, 15)) guarantees consistent 14,400-dimensional latent vectors across both 15x15 compact grids and 28x31 classic arcade dimensions.

2. In-Game State & Adversary Pursuit Mechanics
In-situ snapshot of active gameplay on Level 1 ("Warm-up"). Pac-Man navigates the 15x15 compact grid while Blinky (Red Ghost) executes Euclidean distance minimization towards Pac-Man's exact coordinates.
Figure 2: Level 1 game engine rendering showing Pac-Man, Blinky, pellets, power energizers, and live HUD metrics.
Blinky Pursuit Logic
Directly targets Pac-Man's current tile (r_pac, c_pac) at 0.5 tile/step with 40-step frightened vulnerability periods upon power pellet consumption.
Candy-Crush Star Criteria
1 Star: Complete level. 2 Stars: Finish with ≥2 lives. 3 Stars: Achieve score ≥1,700 through rapid dot clearing and ghost consumption.

3. PPO Optimization Metrics Across Levels 1–10
Episodic training logs recorded in real-time during the multi-level PPO training curriculum. Dashed red vertical markers delineate autonomous level promotion triggers upon achieving 3-star competency.
Figure 3: Smoothed moving averages for Episode Reward, Clear Rate %, Game Score, and Star Progression.
Reward & Value Convergence
Mean episode reward scales from initial negative penalties (-13.2) to robust positive margins (+42.9) with an explained variance of ~0.89.
Curriculum Advancement
The TrainingCallback continuously monitors 3-star thresholds, auto-saving milestone weights and introducing higher-tier maze topologies without manual intervention.

4. Checkpoint Scaling & Baseline Comparisons
Quantitative analysis comparing the untrained baseline agent (RandomPolicy), intermediate training checkpoints (ppo_000 through ppo_100), and the BFS Oracle heuristic.
Figure 4a: Policy progression across training milestones (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%).
Figure 4b: Monte Carlo comparative benchmark across Level tiers (Random vs. Trained PPO vs. BFS Bot).
Zero Wall Collision Guarantee
Action masking reduces illegal movement decisions from 28.4% (Random) down to 0.0%, completely eliminating stationary penalties.
Win Rate Mastery
Trained Smart PPO v3 matches the BFS Oracle with a 100% win rate on early mazes and superior survival time against 4-ghost gauntlets.
